predecessors.name: Spanish Empire
predecessors.text: the Spanish colony of Jamaica: 'English forces launched an invasion of Jamaica in 1655, capturing the existing Spanish colony'

ledger.x: May 1655: English forces take Jamaica from Spain.
1670: Spain cedes Jamaica in the Treaty of Madrid.
18 July 1670: the Cayman Islands are attached to Jamaica.
1749: British Honduras is attached to Jamaica.
15 June 1852: the Bay Islands are attached to Jamaica.
14 July 1860: the Bay Islands are detached.
1872: the capital moves from Spanish Town to Kingston.
4 April 1873: the Turks and Caicos Islands are attached to Jamaica.
2 October 1884: British Honduras is detached from Jamaica.
4 July 1959: the Cayman Islands and the Turks and Caicos Islands cease to be dependencies.
4 July 1959: the Turks and Caicos Islands are detached from Jamaica (infobox 'Detachment...

wars.name: Maroon wars of Jamaica
wars.outcome: No territorial result on the map: peace agreements in 1739 and 1740 (Windward Maroons, Blue Mountains) and the Trelawny Maroons accepted the stalemate in December 1795.

certainty.note: An island: the coast is the frontier; the dependencies (Cayman, Turks and Caicos, Bay Islands, British Honduras) are approximate in the sense of the infobox pairing.
